reuse.why: Selects categories with the existing getMonthFillCategories and converts the sign with the existing spendingToBudgetAmount, exactly as the other month-wide actions do.

duplication.why: The new action contains only its own data source (last month's sum-amount sheet cell); selection and sign rules are shared.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside its siblings and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like the others.

scope.why: Only the action, its registration and its tests.

maintainability.why: A short action that will follow any future change to the shared selection or sign rules automatically.
